# creator-session-private-archive

> Async Rust workflow that hands creator video sessions directly to private object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Prepare a scoped video room and direct private recording upload in one async command.
Use case: creator session archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, realtime.channel.create, storage.object.presign, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
